quote_zh: 室温下将14.0g氢化钾(30％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢化钾溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应
arithmetic_check: Charges. Potassium hydride 14.0 g at 30 percent strength gives 4.2 g, and the stated 0.105 mol implies a molecular weight of 40.0 against KH = 40.11, so the printed triple closes and molar_mass_inconsistent is not raised, despite the chemically odd wording (dropwise addition of a hydride, then complete dissolution in tertiary alcohols). Methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate 34.8 g at 98 percent gives 34.10 g, and the stated 0.1 mol implies 341.0 against C10H10BrClO4S = 341.60, correct to 0.2 percent; the actual mole content is 0.0998 mol, which is the 0.1 mol printed. Solvent volumes carry no mole figures. Product closure. No product mass and no yield are printed for step (1): the material is never isolated, the solvent is stripped and the residue goes straight into step (2), and the only figure given is an in-process chromatographic normalised content of 98.2 percent. There is therefore no mass balance to close or fail, and mass_balance_implausible is not raised. Continuity. The 0.1 mol carried forward into step (2) is the same charge, so no scale_discontinuity. Nothing in this step required a flag; that is the finding, not an omission.

quote_zh: 将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应5h
arithmetic_check: Charges. Trifluoroethanol 13.6 g at 99 percent gives 13.46 g, and the stated 0.135 mol implies 99.73 against C2H3F3O = 100.04, correct to 0.3 percent. Potassium hydroxide 9.9 g at 85 percent gives 8.415 g, and the stated 0.15 mol implies 56.10 against KOH = 56.11, exact. The benzoate salt is charged as 98.2 percent material at 0.1 mol with no mass printed, which is the step (1) output unchanged, so no scale_discontinuity. Product closure. Limiting reagent is the benzoate salt at 0.100 mol (1.35 equivalents of alcohol and 1.5 of base are charged). The product 2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid as named and drawn is C11H10ClF3O5S, molecular weight 346.70, so 0.100 mol gives 34.67 g theoretical. The printed 32.5 g at the printed 97.1 percent content is 31.56 g of pure acid, which is 0.0910 mol, or 91.0 percent on 0.100 mol and 91.2 percent on the 0.0998 mol of methyl ester actually charged in step (1). The patent prints 91.1 percent explicitly as a two-step yield on that methyl ester. IT CLOSES, on either basis, to within about 0.1 percent. Neither mass_balance_implausible nor molar_mass_inconsistent is raised anywhere in this section, and no number was adjusted to reach that result: the printed figures of Example 10 are simply self-consistent. Note that the printed yield is a two-step figure and must not be read as a yield for step (2) alone; that is recorded in notes and not repaired here.
